name: Armand Pizzicarola
description: Armand Pizzicarola is the NY-based VP of Operations at Keepe, a Techstars-backed, Series A prop-tech marketplace, and the builder of PrintStack. This is his personal site: essays on operating, reading notes, and side projects.
bio_html: I'm the NY-based VP of Operations at Keepe (Techstars, Series A, prop-tech marketplace), and I build PrintStack in the wee hours and weekends. I'm interested in how the sausage is made, and sometimes write it down here.
ramblings_note: Anything I write, has been written (or otherwise expressed) before; there is nothing new under the sun.
